texts: Each Keeper eats a small meal at sundown before the shift.
Each apprentice walks to the station with a senior Keeper.

review.notes: Bare-plural verbal generic at 0.9/0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase companion is right, and 'during the day' correctly takes the day-part Time constant rather than During, which requires a second reified eventuality.

fields.sentence: Each Keeper eats a small meal at sundown before the shift.
parse: (: keeper_eat_rule (Implication (Member $x keeper) (And (Member (sk_eat $x) eat) (Agent (sk_eat $x) $x) (Patient (sk_eat $x) (sk_meal $x)) (Member (sk_meal $x) meal) (Member (sk_meal $x) small) (Time (sk_eat $x) sundown) (Member (sk_shift $x) shift) (Before (sk_eat $x) (sk_shift $x)))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The definite "the shift" is encoded as a per-Keeper Skolem term (sk_shift $x) whose typing atom sits inside the rule's conclusion, so each Keeper mints a distinct shift and the presupposed definite is asserted only when the rule fires; a definite picks out a specific thing and takes a top-level constant witness with its Member atom outside the rule, exactly as "the barrel" does in "Coopers do not caulk the barrel".

review.notes: The each-universal rule range and TV, the dependent Skolem meal with "small" split off as its own Member atom, sundown as a bare day-part Time constant, the event-noun anchor's Before relation, and the QuantifierPhrase companion are all correct; omitting Every is right since no frequency wording sits on the time slot.

issues.reason: A definite description "picks out a specific thing" and is "encoded the same way: a typed individual sk_<class>_<n> + its (Member …)", and the on-point precedent "Coopers do not caulk the barrel" puts (Member sk_barrel_1 barrel) at top level with the rule referring to that constant — whereas (sk_shift $x) is a Skolem function, stipulated "distinct per binding", so the parse asserts a separate shift per Keeper and makes the presupposed shift exist only when the rule fires.

adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form emits (: sh (Member sk_shift_1 shift) (STV 1.0 0.99)) at top level outside the rule and orders against that constant inside the conclusion — (Before (sk_eat $x) sk_shift_1) — exactly as sk_barrel_1 is handled in "Coopers do not caulk the barrel"; the temporal-anchor event noun still gets its class atom and the ordering relation and nothing else.
adjudication.notes: The each-universal range and (STV 1.0 0.9), the QuantifierPhrase companion, the dependent (sk_meal $x) with "small" split off as its own Member atom (incidental description, no fusion), Patient for eat, sundown as a bare Time constant and the absence of a tense atom are all correct.

fields.sentence: Each apprentice walks to the station with a senior Keeper.

review.notes: Explicit universal 'each' distributed over (Member $x apprentice) at 1.0/0.9 with its QuantifierPhrase companion; comitative 'with a senior Keeper' correctly CoAgent with a per-apprentice Skolem witness typed inside the conclusion; capitalized 'Keeper' correctly treated as a common noun with no Name atom.
